title: AstroML VariableStarClassification

stats.done_summary: Completed the Variable Star Classification research task. Analyzed symbolic light curve encodings to classify variable vs non-variable stellar sources. Extracted 53 features from symbol series including symbol frequencies, statistical features, transition features, run-length features, entropy, position-based features, and bigram features. Evaluated multiple models (Logistic Regression, SVM, Random Forest, Extra Trees, Gradient Boosting). Best validation accuracy: 0.6262 (Random Forest), but test accuracy was 0.4721, below the baseline of 0.78. Generated comprehensive report with methodology, results, visualizations (confusion matrix, model comparison, feature importance, symbol distributions, label distribution), and discussion. The results suggest the symbolic encoding requires more sophisticated analysis techniques.
